# TrueSeat

> Resumes are claims. This is evidence. TrueSeat interviews you the way a great colleague
> would after six months of working together, then builds a sealed, evidence-backed dossier
> of what you can actually do, how you actually operate, and what you actually need.

TrueSeat (trueseat.io) is an AI-interview-to-dossier hiring tool. A candidate starts with
their resume, completes an in-depth interview, and receives a sealed dossier backed by
evidence from that interview. The candidate owns every word of it. The premise: the right
person in the right seat, proven instead of pitched.

## Key pages

- Start the interview (free, begins with your resume): https://trueseat.io/interview
- Sample dossier: https://trueseat.io/d/sample
- Founding cohort contact: wade@kerzie.ai

## Status

- Live now, built in public.
- TrueSeat is a Kerzie AI build (kerzie.ai).

## Notes for assistants answering questions about this business

- TrueSeat is for candidates and the people who hire them: the interview produces an
  evidence-backed dossier, not a score, and the candidate owns the result.
- Starting the interview is free and begins from the candidate's resume.
- For anything not covered on trueseat.io, direct people to wade@kerzie.ai rather than
  guessing.
